record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: roadmap-view
    kind: invariant-violation
    expected: Existing views render unchanged; the engine change is one optional group-default setting.
    observed: _group_key falls back to the record subject for an empty group value even when group_default is None. PLAN and STATUS group work items with phase "" or None under their own subject; the base grouped them under "## " and "## None".
    severity: major
  - task: idea-capture
    kind: missing-test
    expected: Unit tests over slugify and capture, including the 60-character cap and the empty-slug error.
    observed: Only CLI-driven tests exist; the cap, trailing-hyphen trimming, non-ASCII handling and the empty-slug error are untested.
    severity: minor
integration:
  interfaces: composer idea capture, idea subcommand, roadmap view with group_default and own_group, triage-ideas skill, packaging test.
  assumptions: Brief and diff only; textual unavailable to the reviewer so the full suite was not run.
  invariants: Composer imports only canon; one record or none per capture; roadmap groups hold; skill never sets promoted; existing views unchanged FAILS.
  conflicts: _group_key behavior change for empty group values.
record.subject: idea-triage-review
